querystring.select: SELECT RMMOD.DESCR  AS CustModel, CPJD.JOB_TITLE_NAME AS JobTitleName, RP.PROFESSION_NAME AS ProfessionName
querystring.from: FROM dbo.CUST C WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMMOD WITH(NOLOCK) ON RMMOD.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE='CUST_MODEL' AND C.MR_CUST_MODEL_CODE = RMMOD.MASTER_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.CUST_PERSONAL_JOB_DATA CPJD WITH(NOLOCK) ON C.CUST_ID = CPJD.CUST_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_PROFESSION RP WITH(NOLOCK) ON RP.REF_PROFESSION_ID = CPJD.REF_PROFESSION_ID
